The '''Shoroni system''' was a part of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]] known as [[shoroni sapphire]]s.<ref name="True Colors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[shoroni sapphire]]s|system=Shoroni [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Shoroni [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-9.<ref name="TEA" />
